'''Sadelli''' was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and the older sister of [[Soolami]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Sadelli was a slave under [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavemaster [[Woff B'tar]]. Just before being shipped off to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Sadelli escaped, but still remained in great danger. Fortunately for her, [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] [[JillJoo Jab]] dispatched a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find her and bring her back to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], so that she could be safely transported off Tatooine.<ref name="SWG" />

While the spacer did succeed in escorting her, she would not leave the planet without her younger sister Soolami, who remained in captivity. JillJoo once again dispatched the spacer, this time to rescue Soolami, so that both siblings could leave the planet.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sadelli is [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who perform a series of quests for JillJoo Jab in Mos Espa must find Sadelli and bring her back to the [[City/Legends|city]] safely.
